attr.alt: Dr. Nahlah — Implants and Prosthodontics Specialists
Melanie holding a photograph of her smile before treatment

nodes.v: Not a review widget. Patients of this practice, filmed at it, describing what the treatment was actually like.
Three of them left a line worth quoting.
“My smile held me back. That’s behind me due to my dental implants.”
Melanie’s case is the one the home page opens its transformation chapter with. She is holding a photograph of her own smile before treatment.
“I haven’t stopped smiling since I got my dental implants!”
Yolanda filmed both a testimonial and a longer transformation piece with the practice. Her before-and-after is in the gallery.
Stephen’s testimonial is published alongside the practice’s implant-supported denture work.
Three more told it on film only.
No pull-quote was ever published for these three, so none is written here. The films are the record.
Filmed her story at the practice. Published as a video testimonial without an accompanying written quote.
Filmed her story at the practice. A portrait of Barbara appears in the practice’s own patient photography.
Two patients who went through treatment at the same time and filmed a joint testimonial.
Ask to speak to a patient
Five out of five, and what that is worth.
The practice reports an average rating of
across the reviews it has collected. That is their published figure, and it is the one used on this site — no other number is invented anywhere on these pages.

A perfect average is worth reading carefully, on any practice’s site. What is harder to fake is a patient sitting in front of a camera, named, describing a specific treatment they had. That is why this page leads with the films.
If you want to talk to someone who has been through the procedure you are considering, ask at the consultation. It is a normal request.
The prosthodontist who treated every case on this site.
If what is stopping you is the chair, not the cost.
A consultation includes the 3D scan and a straight answer about what your case actually needs.
Implant dentistry and prosthodontics for Northern Virginia — rebuilding smiles that other practices call too complex.
